title: Berserker's Image
summary: Fight the Berserker's Image through three short protected breaks.
overview: Give Mardic the sealed note to enter the training area. The combat image appears 15 seconds later.
At 75%, 50% and 25% health, the image becomes protected and stops melee for 20 seconds. Wait for each break to finish before resuming damage.

phases.label: Three pauses
phases.description: Each threshold applies a 20-second break, then removes the protection and restores melee.

phases.label: Return from the trial
phases.description: A noncombat image appears and the quest state advances. Follow the return instruction, then hail Mardic for the next step.

sections.title: Trial entry
paragraphs: The sealed note is the trigger for this trial.
